channel.title: Second Eye AI Design Index
channel.description: A governed research index for using AI in UX/UI design, turning tools, workflows, and design signals into cited, multimodal, answer-engine-ready source briefs.

item.title: What Second Eye AI Watches in AI UX/UI Design
item.description: Second Eye AI tracks new AI design repositories, reusable workflows, and feature changes in design and frontend tools, then turns the source-worthy changes into cited, multimodal UX/UI design briefs.
